title: Remapping doesn't work in some places

status.label: Awaiting the requested current-build game retest
status.detail: The July 27 request asks whether the Win+Tab disable rule persists on 0.100.2 or newer and whether it reproduces in #47839; there is no author reply. The latest stable is v0.102.3001.

judgment.rationale: The issue reports that a Win+Tab disable rule still works in the League of Legends client and other games, but lists only PowerToys 0.92.0. A July 27, 2026 commenter asked whether it persists on 0.100.2 or above, requested numbered reproduction steps, and asked whether it reproduces in #47839 or where the shortcut is properly disabled. There is no author response. The latest stable release is v0.102.3001, which satisfies the existing 'or above' request; do not post a duplicate request.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.92.0 and says a Win+Tab-to-disable remap still triggers in the League of Legends client and other games.

A July 27, 2026 comment requests a 0.100.2-or-newer retest, numbered steps, comparison with #47839, and examples where the shortcut is disabled; the comment is minimized as low-quality but remains the only follow-up request.

Related #47839 reports that a global Win+S disable rule still works in Paint on 0.100.2, while another commenter could not reproduce with the classic editor; this is related scope evidence, not confirmation of the Win+Tab game case.
The latest stable PowerToys release is v0.102.3001, and no author response follows the July request.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the author to answer the existing retest and comparison request using the latest stable v0.102.3001; then determine whether the failure is game-specific or shared with #47839.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue's only version is 0.92.0 and the existing request for a current-build reproduction and comparison remains unanswered. The related #47839 evidence does not establish that the specific Win+Tab behavior persists in the reported game clients, so a separate code fix is not yet grounded.

issue_context.summary: A Win+Tab disable remap reportedly still opens virtual desktops in the League of Legends client and other games on PowerToys 0.92.0.
known_information: The issue body lists PowerToys 0.92.0 and says a Win+Tab disable rule remains active in game clients.
A July 27, 2026 comment asks whether the behavior persists on 0.100.2 or newer, requests numbered steps, and asks for comparison with #47839 and contexts where the shortcut is properly disabled.
Related #47839 reports a global Win+S disable rule still working in Paint on 0.100.2; another commenter could not reproduce with the classic editor.
The latest stable release is v0.102.3001, and the issue has no author response after the retest request.
inferences: The behavior may depend on how the game client handles or intercepts Win+Tab, but the report does not establish whether the same mapping fails in current builds or non-game applications.
issue_context.analysis: The existing question already asks for the decisive current-build and context comparison, and v0.102.3001 is newer than the requested 0.100.2 baseline. #47839 has related but not identical evidence because it uses Win+S and Paint. Keep this issue waiting rather than infer a shared defect or repeat the request.
